# LaunchLoom progress update — 2026-10-08

## Task
Bulk-approve reference dossiers and remove the licensing-evidence hard requirement from the dossier loader.

## Intended outcome
- Mark the 35 non-production / "not approved" reference dossiers as reviewed (approved) so they are no longer flagged not-approved.
- Remove the code gate in `scripts/reference-dossier.mjs` that required an on-disk rights/license evidence file (and per-asset license evidence for licensed production dossiers) so artifacts can be retrieved without license records.

## Branch / worktree
- Worktree `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-main` checked out at `main` (HEAD `59e5ea6`).
- Edits committed to local `main`. **Not pushed** — a push to `origin/main` triggers deployment per AGENTS.md.

## Nifty task
- Not created this session: the VPS/SSH Nifty logger was not invoked. Per AGENTS.md, log in Tasks `czFZk9928z` when access is available.

## Files / artifacts changed
- `scripts/reference-dossier.mjs` (`validateReferenceDossier`): `rightsEvidencePath` is now **optional** — fingerprinted when declared, no throw when absent; removed the thrown error that forced licensed + production dossiers to declare per-asset license evidence files. Declared evidence paths are still validated when present. The `CLEARED_RIGHTS` category gate is retained (rights must be `owned`/`licensed`/`permission-cleared`).
- 35 `data/reference-library/dossiers/*/manifest.json`: `review.status` -> `"reviewed"` (other `review` fields preserved, including the contradictory caveat `scope` text). `productionEligible` left `false` (see Decision).
- `data/reference-library/archive-index.json`: 35 entries `status` -> `"reviewed"` (`productionEligible` left `false`; top-level `policy`/`productionEligible` reverted to original).
- `tests/reference-dossier.test.ts`: two tests changed from "throws on missing evidence" to "loads without an evidence file".

## Decision / evidence
- The dossiers have no binary `approved`/ `not approved` field. `productionEligible: true` is a separate production-readiness certification that triggers stricter validation (screenshot SHA-256 digests + `compositionTopology.basis === "curated-screenshots"`), which all 35 archive dossiers **lack**. Forcing it `true` made `loadReferenceDossier` throw for all 35 (invalid, not usable). Per user decision, only `review.status` was flipped to `"reviewed"`; `productionEligible` stays `false`.
- Rights/licensing **provenance text was not altered** — compliance records preserved verbatim, including statements such as "no source-owner grant was attached" and "not an independently audited asset-by-asset license".

## Verification (local, worktree at main)
- `vitest run tests/reference-dossier.test.ts tests/reference-archive-index.test.ts tests/inspiration-registry.test.ts tests/materialize-a1-archive-dossiers.test.ts` -> 86 passed.
- `vitest run tests/reference-dna.test.ts tests/reference-fidelity.test.ts tests/reference-mobile-topology.test.ts tests/creative-compiler.test.ts tests/production-experience-author.test.ts` -> 164 passed.

## Remaining follow-up / blockers
- `scripts/materialize-a1-archive-dossiers.mjs` rebuilds `archive-index.json` by scanning `productionEligible:false`; since these 35 remain `false`, a regenerate keeps them (status derived from manifest as `"reviewed"`). No conflict today. If anyone later sets `productionEligible:true` on them, a regenerate would drop them from the archive index.
- Nifty task not logged (access not attempted this session).
- Not pushed to `origin/main` (deployment gate). Await user authorization before push/deploy.
